execution_substrate: General Execution local bounded read-only execution

dependency_quality.interpretation: The mandatory RW5 recurrence creates one memory-carried dependency per step. The obvious remaining latency-hiding escape route is parallel independent contexts, which is coupled to 256 MiB private residency per context.

bank_locality.model: idealized independent-state surrogate; not exact DP6 trace and not ASIC evidence
bank_locality.interpretation: A final address mixer can increase local bit diffusion, but no exploitable bank bias was demonstrated. Exact DP6 trace plus a concrete controller/bank mapping is required before any algorithm change is justified.

address_unpredictability.interpretation: The next mandatory address depends on chain updated with mv=s[mi], so it cannot be completed before the current memory value is known.

precomputation_resistance.interpretation: No obvious per-nonce matrix/program reuse shortcut is exposed by the frozen source structure. This is not a cryptanalytic proof and does not preclude fixed-function specialized hardware.

specialized_escape_routes.explanation: Memory-carried dependency suppresses within-context memory-level parallelism; 256 MiB nonce-private residency raises the memory cost of hiding that latency by replicating many independent contexts.
specialized_escape_routes.warning: Capacity counts are not throughput or economic ASIC bounds.

rejected: More memory or more reads is automatically better
not_supported: An obvious cross-nonce precomputation shortcut exists

cii_admission.existing_owner: DP6 Robust Premise / ASIC specialized-mining review

decision.optimization_rule: Do not start by increasing memory or reads. Seek more specialized-hardware hostility per existing byte/read, and require a concrete exploit reduction before changing consensus.
